name: Enchanted Being
oracle_text: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to this creature by enchanted creatures.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to this creature by enchanted creatures.

needs.what: a source filter on the `prevent_damage` static (prevent_all + combat_only + affects self_only) restricting the shield to damage dealt by sources matching a filter, plus a filter key matching an 'enchanted' creature (a creature with at least one Aura attached to it)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `prevent_damage` static's `combat_only` + `prevent_all` read only the recipient (`affects`), never the dealer, so it would prevent combat damage from every creature. `damage_source` filters the dealer but is honoured only by `replace_damage` (a multiplier), not by prevention. No static filter key means 'has an Aura attached' -- `attached` / `attached_to_host` describe the attachment itself, not the creature it enchants.
